messages.snippet: Dear Sarah, Following the Series B work last quarter, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter again.
messages.subject: Instruction – Stratton Energy enterprise SaaS agreement
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Sarah,

Following the Series B work last quarter, we'd like to instruct Whitfield Carter again. We're close to signing a large enterprise customer, Stratton Energy plc, onto the Caspian Climate Intelligence Platform, and we need your help with the master SaaS agreement.

Commercial heads are largely agreed (3-year term, ~£450k a year, plus implementation). Stratton are using Denham Lewis. Could James lead day to day, with Elena supporting? Please open a matter and let me know the engagement details.

Best,
Sofia

Sofia Trevino
General Counsel, Caspian Technologies Limited
